sentences.en: Director, I want to start by reading you something that you wrote in the opening pages of your book, actually in the author's note, right up at the top.
sentences.zh: 局长，我想先读一段您在书的开篇写的话，实际上就在作者寄语的最顶部。

sentences.en: You said, all people have flaws, and I have many.
sentences.zh: 您说过，人皆有缺点，我也有很多。

sentences.en: Some of mine, as you'll discover in this book, are that I can be stubborn, prideful, overconfident, and driven by ego.
sentences.zh: 正如您在这本书中会发现的，我的一些缺点是：我有时会很固执、自负、过于自信，且受自我意识驱使。

sentences.en: I've struggled with those my whole life.
sentences.zh: 我一生都在与这些缺点作斗争。

sentences.en: What compelled you to open your book by noting your flaws?
sentences.zh: 是什么促使你在书的开篇就指出自己的缺点？

sentences.en: I think one of the challenges I think I faced in writing this book is a lot of people already have a view of me that is formed.
sentences.zh: 我想，我在写这本书时面临的挑战之一，就是很多人对我已经有一种既定的看法。

sentences.en: And one of the, all kinds of narrative streams as to why I'm a jerk.
sentences.zh: 并且有各种各样的说法来解释为什么我是个混蛋。

sentences.en: But one of the narrative streams about why I'm a jerk is, you know, he's a showboater, he's an egomaniac.
sentences.zh: 其中一种关于我为什么是个混蛋的说法是，你知道的，他喜欢出风头，是个自我狂。

sentences.en: And in part, I wanted to hit that head on at the beginning and be transparent with people about how I think about it, and then talk about how I've tried to deal with it.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，我想在一开始就正面回应这一点，向大家坦诚我是如何看待它的，然后谈谈我是如何试图处理它的。

sentences.en: But you confronted that in a sense by saying, it's kind of true, the ego question.
sentences.zh: 但从某种意义上说，你通过承认自我意识这个问题，算是正面迎击了这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是的。

sentences.en: I don't think I was thinking about confronting it so much as making sure that I am, because I think that's an important part of who I am as a leader,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我当时并不是在想着去正面迎击它，而是确保我是真实的，因为我认为这是作为领导者的我身上重要的一部分，

sentences.en: not just as a person, because so much of what I've tried to do as a leader
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是作为一个人，因为作为领导者，我一直试图做的很大一部分事情

sentences.en: is guardrail around what I think my weaknesses are.
sentences.zh: 就是为我认为自己薄弱的地方设置防护栏。

sentences.en: Really important to me that I avoid the danger, which I think all humans have, but I know I have, of falling in love with my own view of things, my own righteousness.
sentences.zh: 对我来说非常重要的一点是，我要避免陷入那种所有人类都有、而我也知道自己有的危险，即爱上自己对事物的看法、自己的正义感。

sentences.en: And so I really think it was a prelude, and maybe unconsciously, but not explicitly or consciously, a reaction to some of the criticism, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这算是一个序曲，也许是下意识的，但并不是明确或刻意地对某些批评做出反应，如果这样说得通的话。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 说得通。

sentences.en: As you've been reflecting on the experiences of the past 18 months in writing this book and processing everything that happened, can you give me an example of a moment
sentences.zh: 在写这本书以及整理过去18个月所发生的一切的过程中，当您回顾这段经历时，能否给我举一个例子，说明在您与特朗普总统的关系中，

sentences.en: where you were driven by ego, as the phrase you used, in your relationship with President Trump?
sentences.zh: 正如您所说，您被自我意识所驱使的时刻？

sentences.en: I don't know that I can identify one with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我能不能指出哪一个与特朗普总统有关。

sentences.en: I associate a couple of small mistakes I think I made in the Clinton email investigation with, not certain of this, but a risk of ego.
sentences.zh: 我把我在克里希纳邮件调查中犯下的几个小错误——虽然不敢百分之百确定——归咎于自我意识的风险。

sentences.en: I don't consciously associate any of my encounters with President Trump with an ego weakness on my part.
sentences.zh: 我并没有有意识地将我与特朗普总统的任何会面，与我自身的自我意识缺陷联系起来。

sentences.en: And how about the Clinton one?
sentences.zh: 那克林顿的那次呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think that among the screw-ups I think I can identify as one that my children pointed out initially, they called it Seacresting, where I
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为在我能认出的失误中，有一个最初是被我的孩子们指出来的，他们称之为“西克雷st式”（Seacresting），当时我

sentences.en: thought that if- Seacresting as in Ryan Seacrest?
sentences.zh: 认为如果——“西克雷st式”是指瑞安·西克雷斯特吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I'm not looking to pick on Ryan Seacrest, but my kids' take is that Ryan Seacrest was often guilty of this, I'm about to announce this thing, but first, this commercial.
sentences.zh: 我无意针对瑞安·西克雷斯特，但我孩子们的看法是，瑞安·西克雷斯特经常犯这种毛病：我马上要宣布这件事了，但首先，插播广告。

sentences.en: And they said, Dad, you, by waiting till the very end of your announcement on July the 5th to say what it is you were going to do, we think you Seacrested it.
sentences.zh: 他们说，爸爸，你在7月5日的声明一直拖到最后才说你要做什么，我们觉得你太“西克雷斯特”了。

sentences.en: Kind of publicly tortured people.
sentences.zh: 这有点像在公开折磨大家。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I kind of brushed that off.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点不以为然。

sentences.en: And then the more I thought about it, the more I thought, actually, people were confused.
sentences.zh: 但后来我越想越觉得，实际上人们都被搞糊涂了。

sentences.en: What I was thinking was, this is where I think it's an ego issue, is I thought I knew beSt. And that if I announced the result at the front, nobody will listen to what I say.
sentences.zh: 我当时的想法是——我觉得这就是个自我意识问题——我以为自己最懂。如果我一开始就宣布结果，就不会有人听我说话了。

sentences.en: And the what I say about why we were reaching this conclusion and the transparency was essential to people having confidence that we were doing it in an independent way.
sentences.zh: 而我关于为什么得出这个结论的解释以及透明度，对于让人们相信我们是以独立的方式行事至关重要。

sentences.en: But I think the criticism was actually valid.
sentences.zh: 但我认为批评其实是合理的。

sentences.en: But the reason I associate it with ego is I think I thought I knew the right way to do it.
sentences.zh: 不过我把它归咎于自我意识的原因是，我觉得我自认为知道正确的做法。

sentences.en: And in hindsight, especially with great feedback from my family, I don't think I did.
sentences.zh: 但事后看来，特别是在听取了家人给出的极好反馈之后，我觉得我当时并不知道。

sentences.en: I want to come back to this question of you believing you knew the right path.
sentences.zh: 我想回到你坚信自己知道正确道路这个问题上来。

sentences.en: But let's just hold on to that thought.
sentences.zh: 不过我们先保留这个想法。

sentences.en: We want to focus a lot of this conversation on the now famous memos that you wrote as FBI director, documenting your interactions with President
sentences.zh: 我们希望将这次对话的很大一部分集中在你担任FBI局长期间写下的那些现已闻名遐迩的备忘录上，这些备忘录记录了你与特朗普总统的互动，

sentences.en: Trump, and in some cases, President-elect Trump.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，还包括与当选总统特朗普的互动。

sentences.en: You've acknowledged that after the president fired you, you asked a friend of yours to share the contents of those memos, or at least one memo.
sentences.zh: 你已经承认，在总统解雇你之后，你曾请一位朋友将这些备忘录的内容，或者至少是一份备忘录分享出去。

sentences.en: One of the memos, right.
sentences.zh: 其中一份备忘录，是的。

sentences.en: With the New York Times, with the explicit intention of triggering a special counsel investigation.
sentences.zh: 分享给《纽约时报》，其明确意图是引发特别检察官调查。

sentences.en: So take us back to the beginning.
sentences.zh: 那么，把我们带回最初。

sentences.en: Why did you write the very first memo?
sentences.zh: 你为什么写下第一份备忘录？

sentences.en: I believe it was January 6th.
sentences.zh: 我记的是1月6日。

sentences.en: You have just left a meeting at Trump Tower with the president-elect.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚结束在特朗普大厦与当选总统的会面。

sentences.en: So what has occurred in that meeting that prompts you to start to put in memorandum form your experience with him?
sentences.zh: 那么那次会面中发生了什么，促使你开始将你与他的经历以备忘录的形式记录下来？

sentences.en: That meeting had two parts to it, one with other intelligence community leaders present and another without them, just myself and the president-elect.
sentences.zh: 那次会面有两个部分，一部分有其他情报界领袖在场，另一部分没有他们，只有我和当选总统。

sentences.en: The purpose of that second session was for me to brief the president-elect on some salacious material, an allegation that the Russians had
sentences.zh: 第二场会面的目的是向当选总统简要通报一些劲爆的材料，一则指控，称俄罗斯人掌握了

sentences.en: compromising material of a sexual nature on the president-elect.
sentences.zh: 关于当选总统的具有妥协性质的色情材料。

sentences.en: This is the dossier.
sentences.zh: 这就是档案。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A portion of the dossier, the so-called dossier, that related to his conduct.
sentences.zh: 档案的一部分，所谓的相关档案，涉及他的品行。

sentences.en: And the goal of the conversation was twofold.
sentences.zh: 这场对话的目标有两个。

sentences.en: First, to alert him to materials that we were aware of, the intelligence community, that we thought were about to become public and we were right.
sentences.zh: 第一，提醒他注意我们（情报界）所了解到的材料，我们认为这些材料即将公开，而我们猜对了。

sentences.en: And second, in the event there was something to it, one of the things the FBI does in its counterintelligence role is try to do a defensive briefing.
sentences.zh: 第二，万一情况属实，FBI在反间谍职责中要做的事情之一就是尝试进行防御性简报。

sentences.en: That is, if someone is possibly subject to any kind of coercion or blackmail, you tell them, look, we know about this, which makes it less likely that an adversary will be able
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果某人可能受到任何形式的胁迫或勒索，你要告诉他们：听着，我们知道这件事，这使得敌对方利用该信息的可能性降低。

sentences.en: to utilize that information.
sentences.zh: 利用该信息。

sentences.en: But my understanding is that you had never kept memos in this way before and you have served several presidents.
sentences.zh: 但据我所悉，你以前从未以这种方式保留过备忘录，而你曾为多位总统服务过。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I don't remember ever writing a memo about a communication with a president or any other senior official.
sentences.zh: 我不记得自己曾写过任何关于与总统或任何其他高级官员沟通的备忘录。

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不记得有。

sentences.en: I never created a memo of an encounter with the president.
sentences.zh: 我从未创建过与总统会面的备忘录。

sentences.en: So there's something inherent in this president that's different, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来这位总统身上存在着某些不同寻常的特质。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: And is dishonesty in your mind the core?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，不诚实是核心问题吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: The core concern for memo creation?
sentences.zh: 创建备忘录的核心关切？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: The notion that the truth and integrity were not his track record, at least so far as I could see, was not one where they were high values in his life.
sentences.zh: 那种认为真相和正直并不是他的行事准则的看法——至少据我所见，它们在他的生活中并不是什么高价值的东西。

sentences.en: And so the memos are, in a sense, a protective measure in this power dynamic.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，这些备忘录在这种权力动态中是一种保护措施。

sentences.en: Well, a protective measure in the life of the FBI and to protect the organization.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是FBI生活中的一种保护措施，也是为了保护这个组织。

sentences.en: I was having a conversation with the president or president-elect that touched on the FBI's core responsibilities and then involved the president or president-elect personally.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在与总统或当选总统进行对话，涉及FBI的核心职责，然后又牵涉到总统或当选总统个人。

sentences.en: So they weren't about policy questions or things like that, but they're about personal issues.
sentences.zh: 所以它们不是关于政策问题之类的事情，而是关于个人问题。

sentences.en: And I worried that given the nature of the person I was talking to, if it ever became an issue, he might well lie about the content of that communication.
sentences.zh: 我担心，鉴于我谈话对象的性格，如果它日后成为一个问题，他很可能会对那次沟通的内容说谎。

sentences.en: And so I needed to have a written record so I could remember it clearly to protect the FBI and also to protect myself.
sentences.zh: 因此我需要有一份书面记录，以便能够清晰地回忆起来，从而保护FBI，也保护我自己。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because with two people in the room, there's just two possible accounts.
sentences.zh: 因为房间里只有两个人，所以只有两种可能的说法。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Not a third, nobody verifying anything.
sentences.zh: 没有第三者，没有人来验证任何事情。

sentences.en: Unless there's a tape.
sentences.zh: 除非有录音。

sentences.en: We'll get to that.
sentences.zh: 我们待会儿会谈到这个。

sentences.en: What did you do with the first memo after you wrote it?
sentences.zh: 你写完第一份备忘录后怎么处理的？

sentences.en: I can't say.
sentences.zh: 我不能说。

sentences.en: That was a detail that the FBI asked me to take out of the book.
sentences.zh: 那是FBI要求我从书中删掉的一个细节。

sentences.en: And so I can't say.
sentences.zh: 所以我不能说。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So when was the next time that you wrote a memo about your interaction with the president?
sentences.zh: 那么你下一次写关于你与总统互动的备忘录是什么时候？

sentences.en: I think the next one was the dinner on Friday night, the 27th of January, 2017.
sentences.zh: 我想下一份是关于1月27日星期五晚上的晚宴，那是2017年。

sentences.en: At the White House.
sentences.zh: 在白宫。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this is an encounter in which, as I recall, the president asks you for something, something quite valuable to him.
sentences.zh: 据我回忆，这是一次这样的会面：总统向你索要某样东西，对非常对他而言非常有价值的东西。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He asked me for loyalty at the beginning and then again at the end of the dinner, near the end of the dinner.
sentences.zh: 他在晚宴开始时向我索要效忠，然后在晚宴结束时、接近晚宴结束时又再次索要。

sentences.en: And so how exactly does this work?
sentences.zh: 那这具体是怎么运作的呢？

sentences.en: You leave the White House.
sentences.zh: 你离开白宫。

sentences.en: I assume you get into a government SUV.
sentences.zh: 我想你应该是上了政府的SUV。

sentences.en: And how does the memo writing actually unfold?
sentences.zh: 备忘录实际上是如何撰写出来的？

sentences.en: My recollection is that I did it that night as soon as I got home on my personal laptop and printed it out.
sentences.zh: 我的记忆是，我那天晚上回到家一用我的个人笔记本电脑就立刻写好了，并且打印了出来。

sentences.en: My printer created two copies, initialed them both.
sentences.zh: 我的打印机打印了两份，并在两份上都签了首字母缩写。

sentences.en: These weren't on letterhead because these were personal aid to memoirs.
sentences.zh: 这些不是用正式信头纸打印的，因为它们是個人的备忘录（aide-memoire）。

sentences.en: So you're printing them out and signing them.
sentences.zh: 所以你把它们打印出来并签名。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Initialing them.
sentences.zh: 签上缩写。

sentences.en: I think I just initialed and dated them,
sentences.zh: 我想我只是签了首字母缩写和日期，

sentences.en: printed it out and put a copy of my personal safe at home and took another copy to the FBI the next workday and had my chief of staff hold
sentences.zh: 打印出来，把其中一份放在我家里的个人保险箱里，然后在下一个工作日把另一份带到FBI，交给我的办公室主任保管。

sentences.en: it.
sentences.zh: 把它保存好。

sentences.en: One stored at the FBI, one stored at my home.
sentences.zh: 一份存放在FBI，一份存放在我家。

sentences.en: At this point, now that the president has behaved in a way that you find problematic, seriously problematic, are you starting to think about
sentences.zh: 到了这个时候，既然总统的表现已经让你觉得有问题，而且是严重的问题，你开始对这些备忘录的用途有了一点不同的想法吗？

sentences.en: what these memos might be for a little bit differently?
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是传统的记录保存，不仅仅是为了以防万一的一份记录？

sentences.en: Not just traditional record keeping, not just an account in case it's needed.
sentences.zh: 我之所以这么问，是因为据我所知，你写这些东西的方式是非密级的，这表明你可能已经认为有一天

sentences.en: And I ask that because you're writing them in a way, as I understand it, that's unclassified, which suggests that you might have thought that someday
sentences.zh: 可能会把它们公之于众。

sentences.en: they might, for one reason or another, become public.
sentences.zh: 它们出于某种原因，可能会被公开。

sentences.en: Well, I don't think I thought about that at that point.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得当时我并没有考虑过这一点。

sentences.en: I wrote it that way because you can't store classified information.
sentences.zh: 我那样写是因为你不能存放机密信息。

sentences.en: Although your personal safe is secure, it's supposed to be stored in a government safe, it's classified.
sentences.zh: 虽然你的私人保险箱是安全的，但它应该存放在政府的保险箱里，这是机密的。

sentences.en: And so I wanted to be sure that I was storing it appropriately.
sentences.zh: 所以我想确保我存放的方式是合规的。

sentences.en: Right, given especially the investigation you had just been involved.
sentences.zh: 没错，特别是考虑到你刚参与的那项调查。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And even if there wasn't, it's something that is drilled into you when you go into the government, especially in an FBI role.
sentences.zh: 而且即使没有，这也是你在进入政府部门时被反复灌输的观念，特别是在联邦调查局（FBI）任职时。

sentences.en: And so this is about, in the event it's ever needed, to protect the FBI and myself.
sentences.zh: 所以这样做是为了在万一需要时，保护FBI和我自己。

sentences.en: But are you starting to imagine a world in which the behavior you're documenting in the memos might need to be shared more broadly?
sentences.zh: 但你有没有开始想象这样一种情况：你记录在备忘录中的行为可能需要在更大范围内被分享？

sentences.en: I don't think so at that point.
sentences.zh: 我当时不觉得会这样。

sentences.en: I don't think I was contemplating that future.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我没有在设想那种未来。

sentences.en: And my hope was that I would never need the memo.
sentences.zh: 我的希望是永远都不需要用到这份备忘录。

sentences.en: That it would just remain hidden.
sentences.zh: 就让它一直隐藏着。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So then the third memo, and the last one I'm going to ask you about, is about this other moment we've all heard about, February 14th, Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 那么第三份备忘录，也是我要问你的最后一份，是关于我们都听说过的另一个时刻，2月14日，情人节。

sentences.en: The president is in the White
sentences.zh: 总统当时在白

sentences.en: House.
sentences.zh: 宫。

sentences.en: He's in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 他在椭圆形办公室里。

sentences.en: You're in there for a meeting.
sentences.zh: 你在里面开会。

sentences.en: And one by one, the president asks the vice president and then the attorney general to leave the Oval Office and essentially
sentences.zh: 然后总统逐个要求副总统和司法部长离开椭圆形办公室，并且基本上

sentences.en: asks you, once you're alone, if you would consider dropping the investigation into Michael Flynn, if you would consider, makes it sound more of a question than a direction.
sentences.zh: 在只剩下你一人时问你，是否会考虑放弃对迈克尔·弗林的调查，如果你考虑的话——这听起来更像是一个问题，而不是一个指令。

sentences.en: He said, I hope we let it go.
sentences.zh: 他说，我希望我们放过这件事。

sentences.en: So yes, that was February 14th at the end of a meeting that was called for a counterterrorism briefing.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，那是2月14日，在一场为反恐简报而召集的会议结束时。

sentences.en: And so you walk out of that meeting and once again, it feels like at this point, there's a little bit of a system and a threshold in your head.
sentences.zh: 于是你走出了那场会议，再一次，你觉得此时此刻，你的脑海里已经有了一套机制和一个门槛。

sentences.en: This meeting merits a memo.
sentences.zh: 这场会议值得写一份备忘录。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想是这样的。

sentences.en: And by this point, I'd had sort of a sense of when I needed to document something.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，我大致有一种直觉，知道什么时候需要记录些什么。

sentences.en: And so this one clearly needed to be documented.
sentences.zh: 所以这一份显然需要记录下来。

sentences.en: And I remember emailing my staff because I was headed home, it was Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 我记得给我的工作人员发了邮件，因为我正准备回家，那天是情人节。

sentences.en: And one doesn't always go home on Valentine's
sentences.zh: 人们不一定总会在情人节

sentences.en: Day, but I'm married and deeply in love with my wife.
sentences.zh: 回家，但我已婚，而且深爱着我的妻子。

sentences.en: And so I needed to get home for Valentine's
sentences.zh: 所以我需要赶回家过情人

sentences.en: Day.
sentences.zh: 节。

sentences.en: And I remember emailing my staff that the meeting had gone fine, but now I need to write another memo.
sentences.zh: 我记得我给员工发邮件说会议很顺利，但我现在得写另一份备忘录了。

sentences.en: So your staff knows what you mean when you say, I need to write another memo.
sentences.zh: 所以你的员工听到你说“我需要写另一份备忘录”时，就知道是什么意思了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They get it.
sentences.zh: 他们懂的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: In your account of that February 14th meeting in the Oval Office in which the president asks you, says he hopes that you can let the Flynn matter go.
sentences.zh: 在你对椭圆形办公室那场2月14日会议的描述中，总统要求你、并表示希望你能放过弗林这件事。

sentences.en: You said in your book that you had no choice but to stay in the Oval Office alone with the president.
sentences.zh: 你在书中说，你别无选择，只能独自留在椭圆形办公室里面对总统。

sentences.en: Those are the words you used when he asked these other people in the room to leave one by one.
sentences.zh: 当他要求房间里的其他人逐一离开时，你用了这些词。

sentences.en: And I wonder why you didn't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 我在想，你为什么别无选择。

sentences.en: We talked a little earlier about power dynamics, but you are at this point the director of the FBI.
sentences.zh: 我们之前稍微谈到了权力动力学，但此时你是FBI局长。

sentences.en: You are a profoundly distinguished lawman.
sentences.zh: 你是一位极其杰出的执法人员。

sentences.en: You're an independent operator.
sentences.zh: 你是一个独立的行动者。

sentences.en: And you are, by your own description, stubborn and prideful.
sentences.zh: 而且按你自己的描述，你是个固执且骄傲的人。

sentences.en: So why do you have to stay?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么必须留下来？

sentences.en: Why do you have no choice in the matter to be alone with the president in the Oval Office?
sentences.zh: 为什么在椭圆形办公室里与总统单独共处这件事上，你别无选择？

sentences.en: I don't suppose there's literally no choice.
sentences.zh: 我想倒也不是字面意义上的绝对没得选。

sentences.en: I mean, I was not handcuffed to a chair.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我没有被手铐铐在椅子上。

sentences.en: But given that I am the director of the FBI and the president of the United States has, in essence, issued an order for the room to be cleared and me to stay,
sentences.zh: 但鉴于我是FBI局长，而美国总统实质上已经下达了清空房间并让我留下的指令，

sentences.en: it never entered my mind to walk out.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里从来没有闪过走出去的念头。

sentences.en: Just because of my respect for the office, the literal physical office in which I stood, and the office of the president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为我对这个职位、我所站立的这个具体的实体办公室，以及美国总统职位的尊重。

sentences.en: I can't imagine many things people can second guess, but walking out at that moment, I don't think is one that could be fairly second guess.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象人们会有什么好马后炮的，但在那一刻选择走出去，我认为绝对不会是那种会被公正地马后炮指责的事。

sentences.en: But I guess what I'm getting at is why at this point, as FBI director, aren't you doing anything more meaningful about these encounters than memorializing them in a memo?
sentences.zh: 但我想说的是，为什么在这个时候，作为FBI局长，除了把这些遭遇写进备忘录之外，你没有对这些遭遇采取更有意义的行动？

sentences.en: If they're becoming troubling to you, as I think you're suggesting they very much are,
sentences.zh: 如果它们开始让你感到困扰——就像我认为你所暗示的那样，它们确实非常困扰你——

sentences.en: why are you just writing these stories down and locking them away, even if there are two copies,
sentences.zh: 为什么你只是把这些事情写下来并锁起来，哪怕是有两份复印件，

sentences.en: one at the FBI, one at home, and hoping, as you said, that they never end up having to be seen?
sentences.zh: 一份在FBI，一份在家，然后就像你说的，希望它们永远都不需要被看到？

sentences.en: Well, I'm doing more than that, I think, including in the course of the dinner with the president on
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我做的不仅于此，包括在27日与总统共进晚餐的过程中，

sentences.en: the 27th, trying to interject to explain to him why it's important for there to be distance
sentences.zh: 试图插话向他解释，为什么总统和司法部之间保持距离是很重要的，

sentences.en: between the president and the Justice Department, and why I was there a week earlier, about a week
sentences.zh: 以及为什么我在一周前，大约一周前，即2月8日，去跟他的办公厅主任谈过，

sentences.en: earlier, February the 8th, talking to his chief of staff, and part of that conversation was about the appropriate channels for communicating with the FBI.
sentences.zh: 那次对话的一部分内容就是关于与FBI沟通的适当渠道。

sentences.en: But as I recall, that meeting with Reince Priebus ends with him, in your mind, inappropriately
sentences.zh: 但据我回忆，那次与雷恩斯·普利巴斯的会面结束时，在你的脑海里，他又一次不合时宜地

sentences.en: guiding you over to the president once more to have a conversation you didn't even really want to have, but you had it.
sentences.zh: 引导你去找总统，去进行一次你甚至并不是真正想进行但最终还是进行了的对话。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then the day after the Valentine's Day conversation, I spoke to the attorney general,
sentences.zh: 然后，在情人节谈话的第二天，我跟司法部长——

sentences.en: my direct boss, and told him, it can't happen that you're kicked out of a room and the president meets with me.
sentences.zh: 我的直接上司——谈了，并告诉他：绝不能出现你被轰出房间而总统跟我会面的情况。

sentences.en: You have to be between me and the president.
sentences.zh: 你必须站在我和总统之间。

sentences.en: But you chose not to tell the attorney general about what the president had asked of you, which was to drop the Flynn investigation.
sentences.zh: 但你选择不把总统对你的要求——也就是放弃对弗林的调查——告诉司法部长。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: That was a conscious decision, not to tell.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有意识的决定，选择不说。

sentences.en: Yep, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: Because we believe, that was something we had discussed, the FBI senior leadership team, that he was shortly going to be recused or step away from anything related to
sentences.zh: 因为我们认为——这是我们FBI高层领导团队讨论过的事——他很快就会回避或退出任何与

sentences.en: Russia.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯相关的事务。

sentences.en: But why not tell the AG?
sentences.zh: 但为什么不告诉总检察长（AG）呢？

sentences.en: It just seems like the most natural thing to tell your boss.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是向你的上司汇报最自然不过的事了。

sentences.en: Well, for that reason.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就是出于那个原因。

sentences.en: We thought...
sentences.zh: 我们当时认为……

sentences.en: That he wasn't going to be doing it much longer, or is it a little more fundamental that you might not have trusted him?
sentences.zh: 他不会再任职太久了，还是说更根本的原因是，你可能并不信任他？

sentences.en: No, I don't think it was that.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得不是那个原因。

sentences.en: He was so new at that point.
sentences.zh: 他当时上任太新了。

sentences.en: I think he'd only been there a week or so.
sentences.zh: 我想他才刚上任一个星期左右。

sentences.en: And he was, as a legal matter, going to be walled off from anything related to this.
sentences.zh: 而且从法律角度来说，他将被隔离在任何与此相关的事情之外。

sentences.en: And so why would we hand him something when there's already been a conclusion?
sentences.zh: 既然已经有了这样的定论，为什么还要把这件事交给他呢？

sentences.en: And we had heard this from career officials inside the Justice Department, that he was going to be walled off.
sentences.zh: 我们从司法部内部的职业官员那里听到消息说，他将被隔离在外。

sentences.en: So it wouldn't make any sense to hand him this, and then he'd have to be on the other side of a wall.
sentences.zh: 所以把这东西交给他毫无意义，接着他又得站到隔离墙的另一边去。

sentences.en: Forgive me for a second, though.
sentences.zh: 不过请原谅我打断一下。

sentences.en: But if I know my boss, who's just outside this room, is about to not be my boss, I think I'm still going to tell him about a pressing matter that
sentences.zh: 但如果我知道我的上司——就坐在门外的那位——马上就不是我的上司了，我想我还是会把一件让我感到极其不适当的、在我的工作中发生的紧迫事情告诉他，

sentences.en: feels deeply inappropriate, something that's occurred in my work, even if he's not going to be in that job for that much longer, right?
sentences.zh: 即使他不会在这个岗位上待太久了，对吧？

sentences.en: That the sort of chain of command seems important.
sentences.zh: 这种指挥链似乎很重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, it didn't feel that way to us.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们当时不这么觉得。

sentences.en: We couldn't think in the immediate moment about a way to corroborate it.
sentences.zh: 我们在当下一时想不出什么办法来佐证它。

sentences.en: So what do we do with this?
sentences.zh: 那我们该拿这个怎么办？

sentences.en: Because it's just the two of you.
sentences.zh: 因为当时只有你们两个人。

sentences.en: Just the two of us.
sentences.zh: 只有我们两个人。

sentences.en: And so the decision that we made as a team was, we'll keep it in a metaphorical box so it doesn't infect the investigative team.
sentences.zh: 所以我们团队做出的决定是，把它放在一个比喻意义上的盒子里，这样它就不会污染调查团队。

sentences.en: We'll hold it close, and we won't share it with the attorney general because he will be shortly, we think, out of anything related to Russia.
sentences.zh: 我们会把它严加保管，不告诉司法部长，因为我们认为他很快就会脱离任何与俄罗斯相关的事务。

sentences.en: And we'll figure out what to do with it down the road.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会在日后弄清楚该怎么处理它。

sentences.en: Looking back now, do you think that was the right decision?
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，你认为那是正确的决定吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我认为是。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: For the reasons I just said.
sentences.zh: 就凭我刚才说的那些原因。

sentences.en: I don't think it would make sense to be briefing the attorney general on a matter that directly related to the subject from which he would be shortly recused.
sentences.zh: 我觉得向司法部长汇报一件与他即将回避的主题直接相关的事情是没有意义的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And especially because there was nothing for him to do, the important thing, something he could do,
sentences.zh: 而且尤其是因为他无事可做，重要的事情——他能做的事——

sentences.en: is to understand my discomfort with being alone with the president and the importance of staying between me and the president.
sentences.zh: 是理解我对与总统独处的不安，以及保持我和总统之间距离的重要性。

sentences.en: And do you think that registered with him?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他听进去了吗？

sentences.en: I guess that registered in what sense?
sentences.zh: 我猜听进去了，是从什么意义上说呢？

sentences.en: Do you think the attorney general Sessions absorbed your discomfort with being alone with the president and acted on it in such a way that it might not recur?
sentences.zh: 你觉得司法部长塞申斯领会了你对与总统独处的不安，并采取了行动，以至于这种事可能不会再次发生吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: The first part, yes.
sentences.zh: 前半部分，是的。

sentences.en: I think he clearly understood.
sentences.zh: 我想他显然理解了。

sentences.en: And I asked my chief of staff to call his afterwards just to make sure he understood.
sentences.zh: 我让我的办公厅主任事后打电话给他的主任，以确保他理解了。

sentences.en: But whether he could or would do anything to maintain that separation, I didn't see any evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 但至于他能否或是否会采取任何行动来维持这种隔离，我没看到任何迹象。

sentences.en: So in all, how many memos do you think that you ended up writing about your conversations with the president?
sentences.zh: 总的来说，你觉得你最终写了多少关于你与总统对话的备忘录？

sentences.en: I don't remember exactly.
sentences.zh: 我记不清具体数字了。

sentences.en: It's somewhere between five and ten.
sentences.zh: 大概在五到十份之间。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know because I don't have them, but it's more than five and it's less than ten.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不知道，因为我没有它们，但多于五份且少于十份。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And you don't have them because they have been taken from you?
sentences.zh: 你没有它们，是因为它们被从你手里拿走了吗？

sentences.en: I turn them over to the FBI at their requeSt.
sentences.zh: 应他们的要求，我把它们交给了FBI。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So then you are, in fact, fired by the president.
sentences.zh: 所以后来，你实际上被总统解雇了。

sentences.en: Now that I know the chyron that you see first says resigned, which must have surprised you because you did not resign.
sentences.zh: 现在我知道你首先看到的字幕上写的是“已辞职”，这一定让你感到惊讶，因为你并没有辞职。

sentences.en: You were, in fact, fired in May of 2017.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你在2017年5月被解雇了。

sentences.en: And at some point, not long after that, we now all know, you decided you wanted these memos out in the world.
sentences.zh: 而在那之后不久的某个时候，我们现在都知道，你决定让这些备忘录公之于世。

sentences.en: What happened to finally set that decision into motion?
sentences.zh: 究竟发生了什么，最终促成了这个决定？

sentences.en: A middle of the night, which almost never happens to me because I'm a sound sleeper, but a middle of the night lightning bolt revelation, delayed revelation.
sentences.zh: 一个深夜——这对我来说几乎从不发生，因为我睡眠很深——一个深夜里电光石火般的顿悟，延迟的顿悟。

sentences.en: I was fired on a Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我在一个星期二被解雇。

sentences.en: The next few days after my firing, there were articles that appeared in various newspapers where it appeared.
sentences.zh: 在我被解雇后的接下来的几天里，各大报纸上出现了一些文章。

sentences.en: I believe the Times in particular had a story about it.
sentences.zh: 我相信《纽约时报》尤其刊登了一篇相关的报道。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the Times, and I don't know about anybody else, but it appeared that.
sentences.zh: 对，我想是《时报》，至于其他人我就不知道了，但似乎是关于……

sentences.en: About the loyalty.
sentences.zh: 关于忠诚。

sentences.en: Yeah, about loyalty.
sentences.zh: 对，关于忠诚。

sentences.en: And there was something else too.
sentences.zh: 还有别的事。

sentences.en: I can't remember what it was, but that gave the president apparently cause to believe that I was talking to the media, which I was not.
sentences.zh: 我记不清是什么了，但那显然让总统有理由相信我在跟媒体说话，而我并没有。

sentences.en: And he tweeted on Friday after I was fired.
sentences.zh: 他在我被解雇后的星期五发了一条推特。

sentences.en: So three days later, and I may have this wrong, but James Comey better hope there aren't tapes before he starts leaking to the media.
sentences.zh: 也就是三天后，我可能记错了，但大意是：詹姆斯·科米最好祈祷在开始向媒体泄密之前没有什么录音吧。

sentences.en: And I didn't focus on that right away because I was in this place where I was trying to keep all of this out of my head.
sentences.zh: 我当时没有马上关注那个，因为我当时正试图把所有这些抛在脑后。

sentences.en: So I don't remember thinking about it until I woke up
sentences.zh: 所以我记得我直到醒来时才去想它

sentences.en: Monday night.
sentences.zh: ——那是星期一晚上。

sentences.en: So into early Tuesday morning, I think it was two in the morning.
sentences.zh: 所以到了星期二凌晨，我想当时是凌晨两点。

sentences.en: I opened my eyes in bed and thought, wait a minute, if there are tapes, there will be corroboration.
sentences.zh: 我在床上睁开眼睛，心想：等等，如果有录音，那就会有佐证。

sentences.en: It won't be my word against the president's, which was the problem we encountered to begin with, that there are tapes.
sentences.zh: 那就不会是我的一面之词对阵总统的一面之词了——这正是我们一开始遇到的问题——有录音存在。

sentences.en: He will be heard on those tapes saying what I recorded him saying in my memo.
sentences.zh: 人们会在那些录音里听到他说出我记在备忘录里的话。

sentences.en: Someone's got to go get those tapes.
sentences.zh: 得有人去把那些录音弄到手。

sentences.en: And lying there in bed, I thought the FBI will see what I see.
sentences.zh: 躺在床上，我心想FBI会看到我所看到的。

sentences.en: They probably saw it days before.
sentences.zh: 他们可能几天前就看到了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: He has 50 million Twitter followers.
sentences.zh: 他拥有5000万推特粉丝。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I mean, not just see it, but realize the significance of it in connection with the Valentine's Day meeting particularly.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，不仅是看到它，而且要意识到它与情人节那次会面之间的重大关联。

sentences.en: And at that point, my conclusion was I can trust the FBI to see it and to want to go get those tapes.
sentences.zh: 当时我的结论是，我可以信任联邦调查局，他们会看到这一点并希望去获取那些录音带。

sentences.en: But I honestly didn't trust the leadership of the
sentences.zh: 但我老实说，我并不信任

sentences.en: Department of Justice to pursue it aggressively.
sentences.zh: 司法部的领导层会积极跟进。

sentences.en: And so I thought something's got to be done to force them to go get the tapes from the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为必须做点什么来迫使他们去椭圆形办公室拿录音带。

sentences.en: And it's going to take a special prosecutor to pursue those.
sentences.zh: 而这需要一个特别检察官来负责追查。

sentences.en: If I put out in the public square the February 14th, the substance of it, it will be clear the significance of the president's tweet about tapes.
sentences.zh: 如果我在公开场合把2月14日那件事的实质内容抖出来，总统关于录音带的推文的重大意义就会昭然若揭。

sentences.en: And it will force something that otherwise wouldn't happen.
sentences.zh: 这就会推动原本不会发生的事情发生。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, I'm a private citizen now.
sentences.zh: 而且我想，好吧，我现在是个普通公民了。

sentences.en: That information is unclassified.
sentences.zh: 这些信息是非机密的。

sentences.en: And so I will ask a friend of mine to get it out into the media.
sentences.zh: 所以我将请我的一个朋友将其透露给媒体。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it was the mention of the tapes by the president in this tweet that first planted this
sentences.zh: 所以，正是总统在这条推文中提及录音带，首次萌生了这样一个

sentences.en: idea that if I release these memos, I'll trigger the special counsel and we'll get the tapes.
sentences.zh: 想法：如果我公布这些备忘录，就会触发特别检察官的任命，我们就能拿到录音带。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And do you believe that you triggered the special counsel?
sentences.zh: 你认为是你触发了特别检察官的调查吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我并不这么认为。

sentences.en: Again, because I don't have any visibility into what the FBI was doing for all I know.
sentences.zh: 同样，因为我对联邦调查局在做什么一无所知，据我所知。

sentences.en: And I'm just making this up.
sentences.zh: 我这只是瞎猜。

sentences.en: The FBI had already sent a memo over saying, we believe there ought to be a special counsel appointed.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局可能已经发过一份备忘录说，我们认为应该任命一位特别检察官。

sentences.en: That's possible.
sentences.zh: 这完全有可能。

sentences.en: And so I may have had no role, but that's why I say I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我可能根本没起什么作用，这就是为什么我说我不知道。

sentences.en: So do you believe that it would have happened eventually no matter what?
sentences.zh: 那你认为无论如何这件事最终都会发生吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: You can make an argument it would be likely that it would happen regardless.
sentences.zh: 你可以争辩说，不管怎样它都很可能会发生。

sentences.en: The chronology is kind of powerful in terms of timing, your contribution to it.
sentences.zh: 就时间节点以及你所起的作用而言，时间线非常有说服力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, look, that's why I say I think it's possible that I was either a factor or the determining factor.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，这就是为什么我说我觉得我可能是个因素，也可能是决定性因素。

sentences.en: You have told a story a few times about waking up in the middle of the night with this realization that if there are tapes, they might back up the accounts that you have
sentences.zh: 你曾多次讲述过这样一个故事：你在半夜醒来，突然意识到如果真的有录音带，它们可能会证实你

sentences.en: been documenting in these memos.
sentences.zh: 一直在这些备忘录中所记录的说法。

sentences.en: But I have to say in hearing that and reading it in the book, and forgive me, the notion that the president had a secret recording of this conversation at
sentences.zh: 但我不得不说，听到这个说法并在书里读到它时——请原谅我——总统在白宫

sentences.en: the White House has always struck me as implausible and something he just was saying because he was
sentences.zh: 对这次谈话进行了秘密录音的想法，让我一直觉得不可思议，这不过是他因为

sentences.en: angry and he didn't like the fact that you were out there communicating your side.
sentences.zh: 生气、而且不喜欢你公开表达自己立场而随口说出的话。

sentences.en: Did you really believe that he had tapes?
sentences.zh: 你真的相信他有录音带吗？

sentences.en: Certainly not for certain, but I thought there was a real prospect given his tweet that he did.
sentences.zh: 当然不敢百分之百确定，但考虑到他的推文，我觉得确实很有这种可能。

sentences.en: And someone needed to go find out.
sentences.zh: 而且总得有人去查明真相。

sentences.en: But ultimately, was it more important to you that there be a special counsel investigation than that there be a way of getting the tapes?
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，对你而言，进行特别检察官调查是否比找到获取录音带的方法更重要？

sentences.en: No, I don't think more important.
sentences.zh: 不，我不认为更重要。

sentences.en: I mean, what I woke up thinking about was the tapes, getting the tapes, someone's got to go get the tapes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我醒来时脑子里想的是录音带，拿到录音带，总得有人去把录音带拿来。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Is another possible explanation that the president had just fired you, which is a pretty traumatic experience, and one that would be pretty difficult on anybody.
sentences.zh: 另一种可能的解释是，总统刚刚解雇了你，这是一段相当痛苦的经历，对任何人来说都很难熬。

sentences.en: And you knew these memos would cause him a lot of trouble.
sentences.zh: 而你知道这些备忘录会给他惹来大麻烦。

sentences.en: And you sincerely wanted the public to see them.
sentences.zh: 你发自内心地希望公众能看到它们。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's possible somebody else would have thought that, and maybe that's a more noble way of thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，别人可能会这么想，也许这是一种更高尚的想法。

sentences.en: But I wasn't thinking in terms of broader public interest or any of those things at the time.
sentences.zh: 但我当时并没有从更广泛的公众利益或任何类似的角度去考虑。

sentences.en: So your plan, again, is release the memos, get a special counsel, get the special counsel to go get the tapes.
sentences.zh: 所以你的计划依然是：公布备忘录，促成特别检察官，让特别检察官去拿录音带。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to keep interrupting you.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉一直打断你。

sentences.en: Memo.
sentences.zh: 备忘录。

sentences.en: Memo.
sentences.zh: 备忘录。

sentences.en: A lot of people have been talking about memos.
sentences.zh: 很多人都在谈论备忘录。

sentences.en: Single, unclassified memo.
sentences.zh: 单份的非机密备忘录。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the plan is to release a memo, get a special counsel, have the special counsel hopefully get the tapes.
sentences.zh: 所以计划是公布一份备忘录，促成特别检察官，希望特别检察官能拿到录音带。

sentences.en: That plan feels pretty complicated and elaborate in terms of steps and moves and pieces.
sentences.zh: 从步骤、行动和环节来看，这个计划显得相当复杂和周密。

sentences.en: Could there have been a simpler way?
sentences.zh: 难道没有更简单的方法吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 唔。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Maybe you want to suggest one, but that's what I thought of at two o'clock in the morning, is that that would put pressure on, force the Department of Justice to do what had
sentences.zh: 也许你想提议一个，但这就是我在凌晨两点想到的，这会施加压力，迫使司法部去做媒体

sentences.en: been talked about in the media that they were considering doing.
sentences.zh: 一直在讨论他们正在考虑要做的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because you didn't trust the Department of Justice to do the right thing on its own.
sentences.zh: 因为你不相信司法部会自主做出正确的决定。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You said perhaps there's a suggestion.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说也许可以提个建议。

sentences.en: The simpler solution might be just to go to the FBI or the Department of Justice and just say, you should ask for those tapes.
sentences.zh: 更简单的解决方法可能是直接去找联邦调查局或司法部，然后说，你们应该索取那些录音带。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But the FBI already knows what I know.
sentences.zh: 但联邦调查局已经知道我知道的事了。

sentences.en: And so if I can be useful, it's in putting pressure on the Department of Justice leadership, not the FBI.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我能发挥作用，那也是在向司法部领导层施压，而不是向联邦调查局施压。

sentences.en: But given that I lacked confidence in the leadership of the Department of Justice, going to the FBI would be telling them something they already knew.
sentences.zh: 但鉴于我对司法部领导层缺乏信心，去找联邦调查局无异于告诉他们已经知道的事情。

sentences.en: But let's focus on the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 但让我们把重点放在司法部上。

sentences.en: I mean, isn't it a sign that there's something fundamentally broken when the former director of the FBI doesn't trust the Department
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当联邦调查局前局长都不信任司法部、

sentences.en: of Justice or think it's capable of doing its job?
sentences.zh: 也不认为它有能力做好自己的工作时，这难道不正是体制出现根本性崩溃的征兆吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: That you've essentially felt you needed to work around this agency full of law enforcement officials to deal with a situation that ideally they would deal with on a routine basis.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你基本上觉得自己需要绕过这个充满执法人员的机构，去处理一个在理想情况下本该由他们例行处理的情况。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It is filled with law enforcement officials, but it's led by individual human beings.
sentences.zh: 它确实充满了执法人员，但领导它的是具体的个人。

sentences.en: And I knew the attorney general was recused.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道总检察长已经回避了。

sentences.en: And given how I thought the deputy attorney general had handled my firing, I did not have confidence that it would be done in the right way.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我认为副总检察长处理我被解雇一事的方式，我对事情能得到妥善处理没有信心。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 唔。

sentences.en: This is Rob Rosenstein.
sentences.zh: 这是罗德·罗森斯坦。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That does feel like a sad state of affairs.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真是一种悲哀的现状。

sentences.en: Oh, sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: There's a whole lot of sad states of affairs over the last couple of years.
sentences.zh: 过去几年里有太多悲哀的现状了。

sentences.en: But yeah, sure, it's regrettable.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，当然，这令人遗憾。

sentences.en: You write about this in your book.
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到了这一点。

sentences.en: You say about your thinking at the time, I could leave it alone.
sentences.zh: 你谈到自己当时的想法时说，我可以不管它。

sentences.en: I could trust the system to work.
sentences.zh: 我可以相信体制会正常运转。

sentences.en: But you decided in the end that you, as we've just established, that you didn't trust the system and you were going to do things your own way.
sentences.zh: 但你最终还是决定——正如我们刚才所确定的那样——你不相信体制，你要按自己的方式行事。

sentences.en: And that calls to mind some of the words you used to describe yourself in the book, in the author's note.
sentences.zh: 这就让人想起你在书中作者注里用来形容自己的一些词汇。

sentences.en: Overconfident, stubborn, driven by ego.
sentences.zh: 过度自信、固执、被自我驱动。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't think that's fair.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不认为这公平。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不公平？

sentences.en: Because I don't think ego, stubbornness, overconfidence played a significant role in those decisions.
sentences.zh: 因为我不认为自我、固执和过度自信在这些决定中起到了重要作用。

sentences.en: Those are things I always ask myself when I make decisions, but I thought I was quite logical and practical in trying to do something I thought was in the public interest
sentences.zh: 这些是我每次做决定时都会反问自己的问题，但我认为自己在努力做一件我认为符合公众利益

sentences.en: and the interest of the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 和司法部利益的事情时，是相当逻辑化和务实的。

sentences.en: I want to ask you about this because it feels, and please feel free to interrupt me if you think
sentences.zh: 我想问你这个问题，因为感觉——如果你认为我弄错了请随时打断我——

sentences.en: I'm mistaken here, that we're seeing a recurring pattern a bit here in which you lack faith in the system to work through the kind of official normal functions.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里看到了一种反复出现的模式：你对体制通过官方正常职能运转缺乏信心。

sentences.en: And let me give you a couple of examples of where it seems you decide it's important and right to take matters into your own hands.
sentences.zh: 让我举几个例子，在这些情况下，你似乎认为由自己亲自出马既重要又正确。

sentences.en: You felt during the Clinton investigation that you could not entirely trust the Department
sentences.zh: 在对克林顿的调查期间，你觉得你无法完全信任劳雷塔·林奇领导下的司法部

sentences.en: of Justice under Loretta Lynch to handle that probe of the private email server, which prompted you to take it upon yourself to make a pretty unusual...
sentences.zh: 来处理针对私人电子邮箱服务器的调查，这促使你亲自采取了一个相当不同寻常的……

sentences.en: I disagree with your...
sentences.zh: 我不同意你的……

sentences.en: You want me to interrupt already?
sentences.zh: 你现在就想打断我？

sentences.en: I disagree with your predication.
sentences.zh: 我不同意你的前提。

sentences.en: You want to keep going?
sentences.zh: 你想继续说下去吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: Okay, keep rolling.
sentences.zh: 好吧，继续说。

sentences.en: Object at the end.
sentences.zh: 最后再反驳。

sentences.en: Keep rolling.
sentences.zh: 继续说。

sentences.en: It prompts you to take it upon yourself to make this very unusual public pronouncement about
sentences.zh: 这促使你亲自做出关于希拉里·克林顿

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton's use of email.
sentences.zh: 使用电子邮箱一事的极不寻常的公开声明。

sentences.en: And then after that investigation was closed, but new information surfaces because of what happened with Anthony Weiner, and there are new emails, you decided
sentences.zh: 然后在那项调查结束之后，由于安东尼·韦纳事件的发展浮现出新信息，出现了新的电子邮件，你决定

sentences.en: that that needed to be made public, even though it was a pretty significant break with precedent to do that so close to an election.
sentences.zh: 必须将其公之于众，尽管在距离大选这么近的时候这样做是对惯例的重大打破。

sentences.en: And then, of course, in this case with President Trump, you decide to make public your conversations with him through the media to trigger a special counsel investigation.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，在对特朗普总统的这起事件中，你决定通过媒体公开你与他的对话，以触发特别检察官调查。

sentences.en: So please feel free to object if you don't see a pattern there.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你看不出其中有什么模式，请随时反驳。

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我看不出来。

sentences.en: I see you drawing a line, respectfully, as they say in court, through three dots that I would treat differently.
sentences.zh: 恕我法庭上直言，我觉得你是在把三个在我看来应该区别对待的点强行连成一条线。

sentences.en: First, I would point out the context.
sentences.zh: 首先，我想指出其中的背景。

sentences.en: What's different about the memo disclosure is that's a decision I'm making on my own.
sentences.zh: 备忘录披露的不同之处在于，那是我自己做出的决定。

sentences.en: The decisions in the late spring, early summer of 2016, and then again in October, is a decision I'm making with a group of smart,
sentences.zh: 2016年春末夏初的那些决定，以及后来的10月份的决定，是我与一群聪明、

sentences.en: thoughtful people debating it constantly to try to get to the right result.
sentences.zh: 深思熟虑、不断进行辩论以试图得出正确结果的人共同做出的决定。

sentences.en: And they're different circumstances.
sentences.zh: 而且它们的环境不同。

sentences.en: The first circumstance is not about not trusting the Department of Justice, but it's about caring deeply about how the Department of Justice is perceived.
sentences.zh: 第一种情况关乎的不是不信任司法部，而是深切关心司法部在公众心目中的形象。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in light of circumstances that are beyond my control, finding a situation where the
sentences.zh: 鉴于出现了我无法控制的情况，联邦调查局、

sentences.en: FBI, I, and the rest of our team thinks to protect the institutions, we have to do something unusual.
sentences.zh: 我和我们团队的其他成员发现，为了保护这些机构，我们必须做一些不寻常的事情。

sentences.en: Not that I don't like Loretta Lynch, not that I don't respect Loretta Lynch, but circumstances
sentences.zh: 并不是我不喜欢劳雷塔·林奇，并不是我不尊重劳雷塔·林奇，而是种种情况

sentences.en: have created a situation where if we do the normal thing, corrosive damage will happen in the life of these institutions we love.
sentences.zh: 造成了一种局面：如果我们按部就班，我们所热爱的这些机构的生命力将受到侵蚀性破坏。

sentences.en: October is very different.
sentences.zh: 10月份的情况则完全不同。

sentences.en: It's not about the institutions and not being able to deal effectively with a particular leader.
sentences.zh: 这无关乎那些机构，也无关乎无法有效应对某个特定的领导人。

sentences.en: It's about, we're facing a choice.
sentences.zh: 这是关于我们面临抉择。

sentences.en: We have two terrible options.
sentences.zh: 我们有两个糟糕的选择。

sentences.en: Which one is the least bad?
sentences.zh: 哪一个危害最小？

sentences.en: The third one, the reason I don't see the dots being susceptible of a single line, the third one is a decision I'm making in the middle of
sentences.zh: 第三种情况——我看不出这些点可以用单一条线串起来的原因——是我在半夜

sentences.en: the night on my own without probing and debate and cross-examination by my colleagues.
sentences.zh: 独自一人做出的决定，没有经过同事们的探究、辩论和盘问。

sentences.en: And so I see them differently than you do.
sentences.zh: 所以我对它们的看法与你不同。

sentences.en: But in every case, it feels like you're playing things out in your mind and determining how you think things might play out, how they might be perceived, and making a
sentences.zh: 但在每种情况下，感觉都是你在脑海中推演事情的发展，权衡它们可能会如何演变、可能会如何被看待，然后

sentences.en: decision based on your belief of how those things might play out and how those things might be perceived, rather than just following protocol and letting things fall as they may.
sentences.zh: 根据你对这些事态发展和公众观感的信念做出决定，而不是仅仅遵循规章制度顺其自然。

sentences.en: Does that feel fair?
sentences.zh: 这听起来公平吗？

sentences.en: I think that's fair.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这很公平。

sentences.en: And reaching a considered judgment, again, not on my own, a considered judgment with very smart colleagues, that the normal thing will be much worse for the institution.
sentences.zh: 并且得出经过深思熟虑的判断——再次强调，不是我独自一人，而是与非常聪明的同事们共同做出的深思熟虑的判断——认为常规做法对机构的危害会更大。

sentences.en: And that the unusual thing, and this is why I cringe a little at the notion that it's ego, I knew how much this was going to suck for me.
sentences.zh: 而非常规的做法……这就是为什么我对“这是出于自我”这种说法感到有点尴尬，我知道这件事会给我带来多大的痛苦。

sentences.en: I knew my reputation was going to take an enormous hit.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的声誉将遭受沉重打击。

sentences.en: I knew it in July, and God, I knew it in October was going to be even worse.
sentences.zh: 我在7月份就知道，天哪，我知道到了10月份情况会更糟。

sentences.en: And so I don't, you know, I'm trying to cross-examine myself and be fair, but I don't think that's a fair characterization to say it's driven by ego.
sentences.zh: 所以我不——你知道的，我试图审视自己并做到公正，但我不认为把这归咎于自负是一个公正的评价。

sentences.en: I've heard it a lot.
sentences.zh: 我听过很多次这种说法。

sentences.en: I just don't think it's fair.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这不公平。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But even if you're doing this with the most noble intentions, you are someone who believes in the rule of law and in the power of institutions.
sentences.zh: 但即使你这么做时怀揣着最崇高的意图，你也是一个信仰法治和机构力量的人。

sentences.en: How could you not when you are someone who ends up in the job of being FBI director?
sentences.zh: 当你最终坐上联邦调查局局长这个职位时，你怎么可能不这么想呢？

sentences.en: So how should we understand this pattern of using your own judgment and taking matters into your own hands, deciding for yourself what's best, in a sense, for all of us?
sentences.zh: 所以，我们该如何理解这种模式：使用你自己的判断力，由你自己做主，从某种意义上说，为你认为对我们所有人都最好的事情做决定？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think that's a, that's a summation, a synthesis that I would reject at the outset.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个我从一开始就会拒绝的总结、一种综合评价。

sentences.en: Again, I think, I know the human brain craves patterns from data points.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我认为，我知道人类的大脑渴望从数据点中寻找规律。

sentences.en: I just don't see the pattern, except in this respect.
sentences.zh: 我只是看不出有什么规律，除了在这方面。

sentences.en: I'm trying to make decisions in the best interest of the institution, again, at the highest level.
sentences.zh: 我试图从最高层面上，为了机构的最佳利益做出决策。

sentences.en: And the process for making, I keep coming back to this, but the process for making those decisions is really, really important because it's not me waking up in
sentences.zh: 而且做决定的过程——我一直不断地回到这一点——做决定的过程真的非常非常重要，因为这不是我在

sentences.en: the middle of the night, deciding, you know what I need to do?
sentences.zh: 半夜醒来，然后心想：你知道我需要做什么吗？

sentences.en: I need to announce this email thing separate from Loretta Lynch.
sentences.zh: 我需要把这个邮件的事情单独拿出来宣布，撇开洛蕾塔·林奇。

sentences.en: It's an agonizing, considered debate about how to handle a situation, always starting with the top level values of the institution, because there are times,
sentences.zh: 这是一个痛苦的、深思熟虑的辩论过程，讨论如何处理一种情况，并且始终从该机构的最高层价值观出发，因为有时——

sentences.en: and Department of Justice policy recognizes this, when something unusual has to be done that's in the interest of justice.
sentences.zh: 司法部的政策也承认这一点——当必须做一些不同寻常的事情才符合正义利益时。

sentences.en: But the sense that the DOJ won't deal with something, or might not deal with it appropriately, so you're going to.
sentences.zh: 但那种感觉是：司法部不会处理某件事，或者可能无法妥善处理，所以你要去处理。

sentences.en: When I hear you say that, or when I read it in your book, a phrase came into my head, and I'm just going to say what popped into my head right away.
sentences.zh: 当我听到你这么说，或者当我在你的书中读到时，我的脑海里浮现出一个短语，我只想说出我脑海中立刻蹦出的那个词。

sentences.en: It was something that the president said when he was a candidate.
sentences.zh: 那是总统在竞选时说过的一句话。

sentences.en: I alone can fix this.
sentences.zh: 只有我能解决这一切。

sentences.en: I don't think you can read the book and leave the word I or alone in that sentence.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你读完这本书后，还能在那句话里留下“我”或“只有”这两个字。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Because, look, I know my weaknesses, I think I do, and I've always consciously designed teams to guard rail around them.
sentences.zh: 因为，听着，我了解自己的弱点，我想我是了解的，而且我一直有意地组建团队来围绕它们建立护栏。

sentences.en: I think all leaders do, because of the danger of falling in love with your own perspective.
sentences.zh: 我想所有的领导者都会这样做，因为爱上自己的视角是十分危险的。

sentences.en: So I'm ultimately responsible for the decisions, but there was no I and alone in those decisions.
sentences.zh: 所以我最终要对这些决定负责，但在这些决定中并没有“我”和“独自一人”。

sentences.en: When it came to Loretta Lynch, though, you've gone out of your way to explain that you needed a very small group of people to know the decision you were going to be making
sentences.zh: 不过，说到洛蕾塔·林奇，你曾大费周章地解释过，你需要一小群人来了解你将要作出的决定——

sentences.en: about how to discuss Hillary Clinton's use of the private email server.
sentences.zh: 关于如何讨论希拉里·克林顿使用私人电子邮件服务器的事。

sentences.en: So, alone, no, but
sentences.zh: 所以，独自一人，没有，但是——

sentences.en: small circle of advisors, yes.
sentences.zh: 一小圈顾问，是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't know, somewhere between six and 12, maybe 10.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，大概在6到12人之间，也许10人吧。

sentences.en: And so, a pretty good circle at different levels of people, different perspectives, different jobs, and really good
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个相当不错的圈子，由不同层级的人、不同的视角、不同的工作组成，并且进行了非常精彩的、

sentences.en: agonizing conversations to try and figure out what the right thing to do was.
sentences.zh: 痛苦的对话，试图弄清楚什么是正确的事情。

sentences.en: That's why I reject the I and the alone.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我拒绝“我”和“独自一人”的说法。

sentences.en: There are clearly many differences between you and the president, unquestionably.
sentences.zh: 你和总统之间显然存在许多分歧，这是毋庸置疑的。

sentences.en: But do you think that in some ways you were fired by the president because you are both such independent, strong-willed people?
sentences.zh: 但你是否认为，在某种程度上，你被总统解雇是因为你们两个都是如此独立、意志坚强的人？

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: Then why?
sentences.zh: 那是因为什么？

sentences.en: Why was I fired?
sentences.zh: 我为什么被解雇？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I thought it was because of what the president said, that it was because of the Russia investigation, and now I see him saying something different, and both of those can't be true.
sentences.zh: 我曾以为是因为总统说过的话，是因为通俄调查，而现在我看到他说的是另一回事，这两点是不可能同时成立的。

sentences.en: And so, my best information was what the president had said shortly after my firing.
sentences.zh: 所以，我得到的最好信息就是总统在我被解雇后不久所说的话。

sentences.en: I guess what I mean is he repeatedly asked you to stop doing things, stop investigating Michael
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他多次要求你停止做某些事，停止调查迈克尔·

sentences.en: Flynn, or to lift the cloud over his head in another phone call he had with you, and you made it abundantly clear that you were not going to do that.
sentences.zh: 弗林，或者在你们的另一通电话中要求你消除他头顶上的阴云，而你明确表示你不会那样做。

sentences.en: So, here you have two stubborn gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里有两个固执的绅士。

sentences.en: Yeah, but I would, I don't want to be too fair to the president, but I would reject the word stubborn there.
sentences.zh: 是的，但我会——我不想对总统过于公允，但我会拒绝在那里使用“固执”这个词。

sentences.en: Wanting to do things consistent with the norms, traditions, values of your institution,
sentences.zh: 想要做符合你的机构的规范、传统和价值观的事情，

sentences.en: I don't think it's stubbornness.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是固执。

sentences.en: Stubbornness, to my mind, connotes an unreasoning,
sentences.zh: 在我看来，固执意味着一种盲目的、

sentences.en: a thoughtless refusal to do something.
sentences.zh: 一种不假思索地拒绝做某事的态度。

sentences.en: I really wouldn't associate that with decisions that we at the FBI made in this context, including in our interactions with the president.
sentences.zh: 我真的不会把这与我们联邦调查局在这种情况下做出的决定联系起来，包括我们与总统的互动。

sentences.en: I hear that.
sentences.zh: 我听懂了。

sentences.en: For all your criticisms of the president, you did not leave your position under proteSt. You were fired, as we've established.
sentences.zh: 尽管你对总统有种种批评，但你并非以抗议姿态离职。正如我们所确定的，你被解雇了。

sentences.en: I wonder if you thought about what would have happened if you hadn't been fired.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否想过，如果你没有被解雇会发生什么？

sentences.en: Do you think you would still be the FBI director right now?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你现在还是联邦调查局局长吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I mean, again, I can't live an imagined life, but it's possible to have been fired because there was some other collision.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再说一次，我无法去过一种想象中的生活，但有可能因为发生某种其他的冲突而被解雇。

sentences.en: But my plan was to stay.
sentences.zh: 但我的计划是留下来。

sentences.en: In fact, my commitment to stay increased continually because of my role in protecting an institution like the FBI.
sentences.zh: 事实上，由于我在保护像联邦调查局这样的机构中所扮演的角色，我留下来的承诺一直在不断增强。

sentences.en: So, as your displeasure and your alarm grew, your resolve to stay also grew?
sentences.zh: 因此，随着你的不满和警惕与日俱增，你留任的决心也随之增强？

sentences.en: Yeah, probably in tandem, which may seem odd, but given how I felt about the FBI and its role,
sentences.zh: 是的，可能同步增长，这或许看起来很奇怪，但鉴于我对联邦调查局及其所扮演的角色的感受——

sentences.en: as an independent national security and law enforcement organization, I thought it's all the more important that I stay.
sentences.zh: 作为一个独立的国家安全和执法机构，我认为我留下来更加重要。

sentences.en: So, based on what you just said, does any part of you wish that you were still in this job?
sentences.zh: 那么，根据你刚才所说，你的内心深处是否有那么一瞬间希望自己还在这个岗位上？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The part that loves the people and the mission.
sentences.zh: 那个热爱这里的人民和使命的部分。

sentences.en: That's what I miss the moSt.
sentences.zh: 那是我最怀念的。

sentences.en: How do you feel about the fact that the FBI is taking such a public beating right now?
sentences.zh: 对于联邦调查局现在正遭受如此公开的猛烈抨击，你作何感想？

sentences.en: I hate it.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌这样。

sentences.en: I think it's regrettable, even dangerous, and something that people of all political stripes should recognize, not just regret, but work to counter.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是令人遗憾的，甚至是危险的，这是所有政治立场的人都应该认识到的事情，不仅仅是感到遗憾，还要努力去反对它。

sentences.en: Because the FBI is not politicized.
sentences.zh: 因为联邦调查局没有被政治化。

sentences.en: It's being politically attacked.
sentences.zh: 它正在遭受政治攻击。

sentences.en: And we all, I don't care what your political beliefs are, we all need an independent Federal Bureau of Investigation.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人——我不在乎你的政治信仰是什么——我们所有人都需要一个独立的联邦调查局。

sentences.en: Do you hear from your former colleagues with any kind of frequency?
sentences.zh: 你还会经常收到你以前的同事们的来信或电话吗？

sentences.en: I imagine they must be quite distressed, especially given what the president says about the investigation.
sentences.zh: 我想他们一定非常痛苦，特别是考虑到总统对这项调查的言论。

sentences.en: I hear a lot from FBI employees.
sentences.zh: 我经常收到联邦调查局员工的信息。

sentences.en: I've got endless cards and letters and T-shirts and mugs from FBI employees, but I don't speak to the senior leadership that people would otherwise have been around me at the time.
sentences.zh: 我收到了来自联邦调查局员工的无数卡片、信件、T恤和马克杯，但我并不和那些人们平时在我身边的那些高层领导说话。

sentences.en: Does any particular card stand out?
sentences.zh: 有什么特别的卡片让你印象深刻吗？

sentences.en: I actually used to sit on my porch and I could only read them about 20 at a time before I got a pain in my chest from their sadness and my sadness and not being with them.
sentences.zh: 我其实以前常坐在门廊里，每次只能读大约20张卡片，然后我的胸口就会因为他们的悲伤、我的悲伤以及无法与他们在一起而感到一阵痛楚。

sentences.en: So there's none that stand out.
sentences.zh: 所以没有什么特别突出的。

sentences.en: They're just, despite what you may have heard, the best part about my job was my connection to those people.
sentences.zh: 它们只是——尽管你可能听说过各种说法，我工作中最棒的部分就是我与这些人的联系。

sentences.en: And so reading about their grief, which reflects my grief, is the hardest part.
sentences.zh: 因此，阅读他们的悲伤——这反映了我的悲伤——是最艰难的部分。

sentences.en: Do you worry that this book tour that you're on, all the interviews that you're doing, all the things
sentences.zh: 你是否担心你正在进行的这次新书巡回宣传、你所做的一切采访、你所说的这一切话，

sentences.en: that you're saying, will inevitably contribute to that perception of politicization?
sentences.zh: 不可避免地会助长那种政治化的印象？

sentences.en: I worry a little bit, which is why I'm so keen to make sure people understand what this book is about and what I hope to accomplish with this book.
sentences.zh: 我有点担心，这就是为什么我如此急切地想要确保人们理解这本书的内容以及我希望通过这本书实现的目标。

sentences.en: And that if people read it and have the kind of conversation I hope they'll have in the wake of it, it will actually be good for the reputation of the
sentences.zh: 如果人们阅读了它，并能进行我所期望的那种对话，这实际上将对联邦调查局的声誉大有裨益，更广泛地说，它将迫使人们展开一场对话——我们现在正忙于刷推特、为各种人物争吵，以至于没有进行这种对话。

sentences.en: FBI and more broadly force a conversation about something that we're so busy reading tweets and fighting with each other about personalities that we're not having.
sentences.zh: 但这没有意义，因为……

sentences.en: But you yourself decided to become somebody who goes on Twitter and criticizes back.
sentences.zh: 但你自己决定成为一个上推特并进行回击的人。

sentences.en: And so I'm just trying to hold up a lot of a mirror here.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想在这里竖起一面镜子。

sentences.en: Well, sure.
sentences.zh: 好吧，当然。

sentences.en: But I think if you read my collection of tweets, you'll cringe at my photography and some of my quotations from philosophers.
sentences.zh: 但我认为如果你读读我的推特合集，你会对我的摄影技术和一些哲学家名言感到尴尬。

sentences.en: But my goal there in the main is not to be ad hominem.
sentences.zh: 但我那里的主要目的不是搞人身攻击。

sentences.en: And I don't think you've seen me responding to people with ad hominem attacks.
sentences.zh: 而且我想你也没见过我对别人进行人身攻击。

sentences.en: We hate so quickly in this country across policy divisions, policy disagreements.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家，我们因为政策分歧、政策分歧而极其迅速地产生仇恨。

sentences.en: And I'm hoping the conversation that, first of all,
sentences.zh: 我希望这场对话——首先，

sentences.en: I'll model it by acting this way, not hating anybody over their views about policy, but instead urging
sentences.zh: 我会以身作则，不因任何人在政策观点上的不同而仇恨任何人，而是敦促人们关注那件更高尚、更重要的事情。

sentences.en: people to focus on that thing, which is higher than that and more important than that.
sentences.zh: 但假设你还在你的岗位上。

sentences.en: But let's say you were still in your role.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们目前处于这场风波的这个阶段，你想象一下你现在会在做什么？

sentences.en: What do you imagine you would be doing right now, given where we are in this saga?
sentences.zh: 我会在监督一个联邦调查局团队，该团队将继续调查

sentences.en: I would be supervising an FBI team that was continuing an investigation of
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯对美国大选的干预，以及任何美国人在协助或密谋配合俄罗斯方面可能扮演的角色。
